before: Direct AI edits recorded pending ledger changes but had no presentation; pending changes stayed unrevealed until a host revealed them.
after: playDirectChanges presents the pending changes of one committed direct edit with fixed-position overlays and a labelled AI caret, reveals each target through the native reveal API, reveals each change in the ledger as its step ends, and caps a burst at 4000 ms.
reason: Presentation only. Playback reads the canonical part and painted fragments and never writes the document, shared state, payloads, or journals; cancelling keeps the committed edit.
